name: Arabian Internet and Communication Services Company
summary: Arabian Internet and Communication Services Company offers information communication and technology and other services to healthcare, real estate, education, government, oil and gas, telecom, and banking sectors. It engages in the extension, installation, managing, and monitoring of computer networks, wiring, and communications; road repair, maintenance, and supplies; installation, repair, maintenance, environmental monitoring, and control operation; and provision of system integration, connectivity, business outsourcing, cybersecurity integration, managed, senior management advisory, and engineering consultations services.
